ultimate_spider_ham.title: SPECTACULAR SPIDER-HAM
ultimate_spider_ham.text: Defying all laws of physics (and logic), Spider-Ham utilized pure cartoon nonsense to completely dismantle the villain's operation.

deck.name: Toony Web
deck.effect_text: If you end your turn in the Villain's Location, negate to the next Villain movement.

deck.name: Toony Essence
deck.effect_text: Until the beginning of your next turn, you cannot be forced to discard your last card.
